---
title: Discourse
description: Privacy rules for Discourse 2026.1 to 2026.11 on PostgreSQL
---

Covers forum users' names, e-mail and IP addresses, profiles, password hashes, and tokens, including copies in logs, mail tables, user search, and bundled plugins.

## Coverage

- **Versions:** 2026.1 to 2026.11.
- **Engines:** PostgreSQL.
- **Table prefix:** the template assumes unprefixed table names. Discourse uses no table prefix.

<Callout type="warn">
Restoring a backup moves the previous tables into a `backup` schema for up to 7 days. The keys name `public` only, so `backup.users` and the rest come back unredacted. Drop the `backup` schema after a restore, or add each key again as `backup.<table>.<column>`.
</Callout>

## Template

```yaml
privacy:
  rules:
    emails:
      columns:
        - user_emails.email
        - user_emails.normalized_email
        - email_tokens.email
        - email_login_codes.email
        - email_change_requests.old_email
        - email_change_requests.new_email
        - invites.email
        - screened_emails.email
        - user_histories.email
        - email_logs.to_address
        - email_logs.cc_addresses
        - email_logs.bcc_addresses
        - skipped_email_logs.to_address
        - incoming_emails.from_address
        - incoming_emails.to_addresses
        - incoming_emails.cc_addresses
        - single_sign_on_records.external_email
        - user_open_ids.email
        - oauth2_user_infos.email
        - dsa_notices.email
        # Bundled plugins (optional)
        - github_commits.email
        - blog_review_feedback.email
      entity: EMAIL_ADDRESS
      operator: hash
    names:
      columns:
        - users.username
        - users.username_lower
        - users.name
        - user_search_data.raw_data
        - user_search_data.search_data
        - single_sign_on_records.external_username
        - single_sign_on_records.external_name
        - oauth2_user_infos.name
        - dsa_notices.name
        # Bundled plugins (optional)
        - blog_review_feedback.name
        - calendar_events.username
        - discourse_automation_pending_pms.target_usernames
      entity: PERSON
      operator: hash
    addresses:
      columns:
        - user_profiles.location
      entity: LOCATION
      operator: hash
    birth-dates:
      columns:
        - users.date_of_birth
      entity: DATE_OF_BIRTH
      operator: replace
    urls:
      columns:
        - user_profiles.website
        - user_open_ids.url
        - single_sign_on_records.external_avatar_url
      entity: URL
      operator: replace
    ip-addresses:
      columns:
        - users.ip_address
        - users.registration_ip_address
        - user_ip_address_histories.ip_address
        - screened_ip_addresses.ip_address
        - screened_emails.ip_address
        - user_auth_tokens.client_ip
        - user_auth_token_logs.client_ip
        - user_histories.ip_address
        - search_logs.ip_address
        - topic_views.ip_address
        - topic_link_clicks.ip_address
        - incoming_links.ip_address
        - user_profile_views.ip_address
        - browser_pageview_events.ip_address
        - browser_pageview_events_backup.ip_address
      entity: IP_ADDRESS
      operator: hash
    user-agents:
      columns:
        - user_auth_tokens.user_agent
        - user_auth_token_logs.user_agent
        - search_logs.user_agent
        - post_stats.writing_device_user_agent
        - browser_pageview_events.user_agent
        - browser_pageview_events_backup.user_agent
      entity: USER_AGENT
      operator: hash
    text:
      columns:
        - user_profiles.bio_raw
        - user_profiles.bio_cooked
        # Bundled plugins (optional)
        - blog_review_feedback.message
      entity: FREE_TEXT
      operator: replace
    passwords:
      columns:
        - user_passwords.password_hash
        - user_passwords.password_salt
      entity: PASSWORD_HASH
      operator: redact
    plaintext-passwords:
      columns:
        - groups.email_password
      entity: PASSWORD
      operator: redact
    tokens:
      columns:
        - user_auth_tokens.auth_token
        - user_auth_tokens.prev_auth_token
        - user_auth_token_logs.auth_token
        - retired_user_auth_tokens.token_hash
        - retired_user_auth_tokens.previous_token_hash
        - email_tokens.token_hash
        - invites.invite_key
        - invites.email_token
        - unsubscribe_keys.key
        - post_reply_keys.reply_key
        # Bundled plugins (optional)
        - ai_artifact_shares.share_key
        - shared_ai_conversations.share_key
        - blog_reviews.token
      entity: AUTH_TOKEN
      operator: redact
    otp-secrets:
      columns:
        - email_login_codes.code_hash
        - user_second_factors.data
      entity: OTP_SECRET
      operator: redact
    secrets:
      columns:
        - api_keys.key_hash
        - api_keys.truncated_key
        - user_api_keys.key_hash
        - web_hooks.secret
        - mcp_oauth_access_tokens.token_hash
        - mcp_oauth_refresh_tokens.token_hash
        - mcp_oauth_authorization_codes.code_hash
        # Bundled plugins (optional)
        - ai_secrets.secret
        - llm_models.api_key
        - embedding_definitions.api_key
        - decision_models.api_key
        - ai_mcp_oauth_tokens.access_token
        - ai_mcp_oauth_tokens.refresh_token
        - incoming_chat_webhooks.key
        - blog_publications.schedule_token
      entity: API_KEY
      operator: redact
    private-keys:
      columns:
        - remote_themes.private_key
      entity: PRIVATE_KEY
      operator: redact
    # Optional: mixed-content columns. Ruling them hides their non-personal content too; remove to keep it readable.
    mixed-content:
      columns:
        - user_custom_fields.value
        - user_associated_accounts.info
        - user_associated_accounts.extra
        - single_sign_on_records.last_payload
        - incoming_emails.raw
        - incoming_emails.subject
        - incoming_emails.error
        - incoming_emails.rejection_message
        - email_logs.raw
        - posts.raw_email
        - user_histories.details
        - user_histories.context
        - user_histories.subject
        - user_histories.previous_value
        - user_histories.new_value
        - reviewables.payload
        - notifications.data
        - plugin_store_rows.value
        - message_bus.data
        - ai_api_audit_logs.raw_request_payload
        - ai_api_audit_logs.raw_response_payload
      entity: MIXED_CONTENT
      operator: replace
    # Keep: mixed-content columns that hold credentials.
    mixed-content-secrets:
      columns:
        - site_settings.value
        - user_associated_accounts.credentials
        - push_subscriptions.data
        # Bundled plugins (optional)
        - discourse_workflows_credentials.data
      entity: MIXED_CONTENT
      operator: redact
```

**Choices**

- `user_search_data.raw_data` and `search_data` copy usernames, names, and user fields; `users.username` and `username_lower` share a token only when the username is lower case.
- Stored token hashes (`key_hash`, `auth_token`, `token_hash`, `code_hash`) are redacted: a hash is enough to look the row up.
- Address lists (`cc_addresses`, `bcc_addresses`, `to_addresses`) are hashed whole: a list's token never equals one address's token.
- Bundled plugins ship in core; a disabled plugin's tables exist once its migrations have run, so keep their columns unless the plugin never ran.
- Optional parts: delete the commented plugin columns you do not need and the `mixed-content` rule if the assistant needs those columns readable.

<Callout type="warn">
Without `mixed-content-secrets`, `site_settings.value` returns OAuth client secrets and storage keys set in the admin panel, and `user_associated_accounts.credentials` returns users' provider tokens.
</Callout>

## Trade-offs

- **Indexed ruled columns:** `users.username`, `username_lower`, `ip_address`; `user_emails.email`, `normalized_email`; `screened_emails.email`; `screened_ip_addresses.ip_address`; `invites.email`; most token columns; `user_search_data.search_data`, `notifications.data` (mixed-content); plugin share keys.
- **Lookups that stop working:** a user by username or e-mail, accounts sharing an IP, matching `screened_ip_addresses`, a session by token, user search.
- **Join keys that stay unruled:** `id` and `user_id` columns, plus `user_histories.acting_user_id` and `target_user_id`.
- **Multisite:** each site has its own database; run one <Dbmcp /> config per site with that site's `database.name`.

## Not covered

- `posts.raw`, `cooked`, `post_revisions`, `chat_messages.message`, `drafts.data`: user content.
- `web_crawler_requests.user_agent`: crawler user agents, counted per day.
- `search_logs.term`: search queries, mostly topics.
- `user_associated_accounts.provider_uid`, `single_sign_on_records.external_id`: join keys to identity providers.
- `users.title`, `user_statuses.description`: labels the user chooses.
- Uploads, backups on disk or S3, Redis: outside PostgreSQL.
